title: Tenma Tsukasa — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That concludes our debrief for today's show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland will be undergoing some scheduled maintenance tomorrow, so the Wonder Stage will also be closed. Please take this opportunity to rest and recharge!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Okay♪
Okay.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What is it, Rui...?
Why are you snickering while looking my way?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, is that what you saw?
In that case, you were just imagining things.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your smile is only making me more concerned... But we'll leave it at that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By the way, Tsukasa, your birthday is fast approaching, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right☆ Promise to visit on the day of, okay?! We can all celebrate together♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you, KAITO, Miku!
Yes, I promise to visit. It'd be great to do a show as well!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For now, see you later!
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa, welcome home!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Perfect timing too.
Here. This is addressed to you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What's this? A small package...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll be practicing in my room♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course. Thank you, Saki.
Now, who sent me this package...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's from... “The fan of a future star”?!
Ah, I must open this at once!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's see what's inside... Hm?
Just a sealed white letter?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If it's fan mail... No, this seems too anachronistic. It's straight out of a historical movie or something.

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line: “Letter of Challenge”...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-It's actually one of these...?!

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line:
“Letter of Challenge...
To the so-called 'future star' who unwittingly opened this little package...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Ah, this is supposed to be some sort of mind game or psychological trap?!

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line: “Calling yourself a 'future star' is all well and good, but it is high time you showed me your true capabilities.”

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line: “Thus, I have prepared three trials for you. As for what they entail... Hehehe. You'll just have to wait and find out.”

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line: “Of course, whether or not you accept this challenge is entirely up to you. After all, not partaking in a game you know you will lose is a valid stratagem.”

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line: “However, if you wish to accept, stand before the Phenny statue in Phoenix Wonderland tomorrow at noon.”

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line: “Feel grateful that I chose a familiar location that will allow you to spread your wings and put your full potential on display.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr! I have no idea who this person is, but I can already hear them cackling like a hyena!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So be it! As a future star, I shall show them just who they're dealing with here!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! Rui! Rui!
Saki says that Tsukasa just left their house!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you, Emu.
Alright, all according to plan so far.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Operation Big Birthday Surprise is go!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I still can't believe your brothers agreed to let us do this. Lucky for us, we get to hog the park since it's closed today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. They said it's a special treat because we've been going so well as ambassadors♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We really need to thank all of you as well for helping us. This wonderful surprise wouldn't have been possible without your support.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I was hoping to give back somehow since you always put on such fun shows and even celebrated my own birthday!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I owe Tsukasa quite a lot as well, so I'm glad you asked me to help with this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Totally!
Let's give him a big celebration together, Li'l Bro♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? I don't really owe him anything and I didn't ask to be a part of this. If anything, I was dragged in.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You say that, but you seemed pretty excited when we were setting up all the trials.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We appreciate you joining us today as well. I really wasn't expecting you to agree to this.
Oh? I'm just interested in putting our self-proclaimed “future star” to the test is all.
It's important to see if he's worthy of representing Phoenix Wonderland as an ambassador moving forward.
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That letter said to stand in front of the Phenny statue... Which should be this one...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? I spy a suspicious-looking digital timer and tablet. Does this mean I'm supposed to look at the tablet...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's see... “Trial 1. Perfectly memorize the dance routine in the video within five minutes.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! The video's already playing?!
Wait, the timer's counting down too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. But I have nothing to worry about. I'm more than used to dealing with Rui, Emu, Miku and the others' antics at this point.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This dance routine's nothing like the musical numbers I'm more familiar with learning.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I see... The dancers in the video aren't letting their centers drift at all. Not only that, their footwork's outstanding!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But they're wearing their hats in such a way that I can't see their faces. Still, why does it feel like I've seen them before somewhere...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, no! The first trial's underway! I need to focus on memorizing the dance routine!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four...!
One, two... Done!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
How's that?! In less than five minutes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? That sound...
It certainly gives me the impression that I passed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, the tablet's showing a map now!
I see. My next stop is just in front of the Trampoline Dome.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
I shall elegantly achieve perfection with the next trial as well!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess that dance was too easy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, it definitely wasn't.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The video itself was like a minute and a half, so that's two play-throughs tops given the time limit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True. To be fair, I practiced dancing it with Akito, but I couldn't learn it in five minutes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Plus, it involves some tricky steps and really quick turns.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. But Tsukasa looked so cool when he got it down.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
He even seemed to enjoy it towards the end.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Grr...
I should've picked a tougher one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! You're just like Ena!
She hates losing so much♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, our big surprise is still rolling, so let's hurry and get the next spot set up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. We'll need to make sure he has fun all the way through until the end.
